chapter: West Coast trip and Mildred's circle
title: Paul Whiteman Club lunches in California
summary: He describes the monthly luncheons of former Whiteman musicians at the Hillcrest, attended by Izzy Friedman, Johnny Mercer and Al Rinker.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: And I didn't hear from him for years and we'd have a Paul Whiteman Club in California. We meet at the Hillcrest probably once a month or so, we have lunch.

-- old Whiteman musicians -- Izzy Friedman, Isaac Free- man, he used to play clarinet with Whiteman, who went to California and became oh, he contracted for all those -- the bands for all those musicals at MGM and all those things.
And he's more or less the president of the Club, Warren Malnfok's there, Harry Ward comes, Johnny Mercer, come and Al and -- different ones.
Charlie and Tea garden (unintelligible) will come down from Las Vegas --
-- and it's a great luncheon and we cut up touches -- and
Just kind of relax. And so I see Al -- see all of them there.
